demonstrator_D01_D07.text: Contracts and policy (span/evidence/proposal/result structures; separate keep vs replace).
Limited reproducible data import with manifest and correct missing-data distinction (EXACT/CENSORED/UNAVAILABLE).
Protection and original-position mapping; tokenization without changing the original; code/URL/Unicode tests.

Confirmation and patcher: code accepts or rejects proposals and preserves all other segments.
CLI and first review: display original, proposals, final version and reasons; real cases are not hard-coded special rules.
